article_title: Iconic Bitcoin mine pivots to AI as industry turns back on crypto

tasks.prompt: What industry change is the article mainly describing?
options: Bitcoin-mining businesses are adapting some computing sites for artificial-intelligence work
AI companies are abandoning computers and buying paper records
Every cryptocurrency business has stopped using electricity
Bitcoin transactions are now verified by restaurant workers
tasks.correct_answer: Bitcoin-mining businesses are adapting some computing sites for artificial-intelligence work
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה מתארת כיצד חברות כריית ביטקוין מפנות חלק מהתשתיות עתירות המחשוב שלהן לעבודה עבור תחום הבינה המלאכותית.

tasks.prompt: What had the large warehouses originally been built to do?
options: Store printed banknotes for national governments
Run powerful machines that help verify Bitcoin transactions
Manufacture household batteries by hand
Train only university students in programming
tasks.correct_answer: Run powerful machines that help verify Bitcoin transactions
tasks.explanation_hebrew: המחסנים נבנו עבור מחשבים רבי־עוצמה המשתתפים בתהליך הכרייה ומסייעים לאמת עסקאות ביטקוין.

tasks.prompt: Which existing asset makes former Bitcoin-mining sites attractive for AI computing?
options: Large supplies of connected electrical power and data-centre infrastructure
A collection of paper cryptocurrency certificates
Fields that require no internet connection
A ban on installing new computer hardware
tasks.correct_answer: Large supplies of connected electrical power and data-centre infrastructure
tasks.explanation_hebrew: לאתרי הכרייה כבר יש חיבורי חשמל משמעותיים ותשתית של מרכזי נתונים, ולכן ניתן להתאים אותם לעומסי מחשוב של AI.

tasks.prompt: Why did a slump in Bitcoin strengthen the case for pivoting toward AI?
options: It made every mining machine twice as efficient
It removed the need for expensive electricity
It guaranteed that all Bitcoin holdings would rise
It made mining returns less attractive while demand for AI computing remained strong
tasks.correct_answer: It made mining returns less attractive while demand for AI computing remained strong
tasks.explanation_hebrew: ירידה במחיר ובכדאיות הכרייה מצמצמת הכנסות, בעוד שהביקוש לכוח מחשוב עבור AI מציע שימוש חלופי בתשתית.

tasks.prompt: What does “pivoting” mean when a mining company is pivoting to AI?
options: Hiding all of its financial records
Moving every warehouse to another country
Changing its business direction toward a new use
Returning broken computers to customers
tasks.correct_answer: Changing its business direction toward a new use
tasks.explanation_hebrew: pivoting פירושו שינוי כיוון עסקי: מעבר מכריית מטבעות לשימוש בתשתית עבור מחשוב AI.

tasks.prompt: In the article, what does “infrastructure” refer to most directly?
options: The changing market price of a single coin
The power connections, buildings and computing facilities needed to operate
A list of analysts' personal opinions
The digital design printed on a Bitcoin
tasks.correct_answer: The power connections, buildings and computing facilities needed to operate
tasks.explanation_hebrew: infrastructure היא התשתית הפיזית והתפעולית — מבנים, חשמל ומתקני מחשוב — שמאפשרת להפעיל את האתר.

tasks.prompt: Explain how Bitcoin mining and AI computing can use some of the same site resources.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין לפחות שני משאבים משותפים ולהסביר בקצרה את השימוש בהם.
expected_points: Both require substantial electrical power
Both use large data-centre or warehouse spaces
Both require powerful computing hardware
Both depend on cooling and reliable technical infrastructure
Existing grid connections can be reused even if specialised machines must change

tasks.prompt: Why is the industry's shift from crypto mining to AI likely to be gradual rather than immediate?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להסביר לפחות שתי סיבות תפעוליות או עסקיות לכך שהמעבר הדרגתי.
expected_points: AI workloads may require different hardware from Bitcoin mining
Sites may need upgrades to power, cooling or reliability
Companies have existing mining equipment, contracts or Bitcoin holdings
The relative profitability of Bitcoin and AI can change
Not every mining site is equally suitable for AI customers
Some firms may continue both activities during the transition

tasks.prompt: Summarise why former Bitcoin-mining companies are interested in AI and what resources they can reuse.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לסכם את המניע הכלכלי ואת יתרונות התשתית, ולהזכיר שהמעבר אינו בהכרח מלא או מיידי.
expected_points: Bitcoin's slump reduced the attraction or profitability of mining
Demand for AI computing created another potential revenue source
Mining firms already control large amounts of power
They have warehouses and data-centre infrastructure
Some hardware or facilities must be adapted for AI
The broader shift is gradual and companies may retain some crypto activity or holdings

tasks.prompt: Write a short recommendation to a Bitcoin-mining company considering an AI pivot. Use two lessons from the article.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להציע המלצה מנומקת באנגלית המבוססת על לפחות שני לקחים קונקרטיים מן הכתבה.
expected_points: Assess whether the site's power and data-centre infrastructure suit AI workloads
Compare expected AI revenue with volatile mining returns
Budget for different or upgraded hardware
Plan for cooling, reliability and customer requirements
Consider a gradual or mixed transition rather than an abrupt change
Account for the company's remaining Bitcoin equipment and holdings
